title: Zindaan ke Andhere Me Ye Kehti Thi Sakina
body:
Zindan ke andhere me ye kheti thi Sakina
<<MINI>>
Kab aaoge baba mere kab aaoge baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaano se lahu bhaitha hai ruksar hai neele
Zalim ne tamacho se diya apka pursa
Yaad aati hai reh-reh ke mujhe apne watan ki
Kab hoga arman mere dil ke ye poore
<<DIVIDER>>
Bandhi gayi bazu me phuphi-jaan ke rassi
Bhayya ko sitam-garoun ne zanjeer me jakda
Taqat nahi ab zulm-o-sitam she-ne ki mujh-me
Kya mere muqaddar me hai bas sheliyan khana
<<DIVIDER>>
Neend aati nahi qahk pe sou bhala kaise
Yaad aata hai reh-reh ke mujhe baap ka seena
Har zulm saha maine judai sahu kaise
Bin apke jeena mera dushwar hai baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Sahil yahi khe-khe ke qaza kar-gayi bacchi
<<MINI>>
Kab aaoge baba mere kab aaoge baba
